name: app-client-request-slide-with-cutout-founder-and-blue-spray-swoosh
title: Client Request with Founder Cut-Out and Blue Spray
whatItIs: A pale grey slide with a numbered Client Request pill, a large headline fading as it descends, a small avatar overlapping the first line, a quote with bold key words beside a grainy blue spray swoosh, a name and role beside a blue line and a large cut-out portrait fading out at the bottom.
whatItMeans: A portrait fading into the page makes the client feel present, and the spray swoosh adds a burst of energy.
techniques: Grainy blue spray swoosh crossing the quote
Bold key words within a grey quote

vocabulary.definition: A photo whose lower part dissolves into the page colour.
A soft grainy stroke of colour.
A small portrait placed over the end of a headline line.
